definitions.explanation: The quality of being original; the ability to create new and unique ideas or works.

examples.japanese: {独創性|どくそうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発揮|はっき}→発揮：00086_hakki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{独創性|どくそうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{独創性|どくそうせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{欠|か}ける→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧⟦{提案|ていあん}→提案：03536_teian⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It's a proposal that lacks originality.

notes:
{独創性|どくそうせい} refers to the quality of producing something new and unique — originality in thought, art, or work. It emphasizes the "creating something that didn't exist before" aspect of creativity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {独創性|どくそうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have originality
- {独創性|どくそうせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{欠|か}ける→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧: to lack originality
- {独創性|どくそうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発揮|はっき}→発揮：00086_hakki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to display originality
- {独創性|どくそうせい}⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧な: rich in originality
- {独創性|どくそうせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富|と}む→富む：12343_tomu⟧: to be full of originality

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {独創性|どくそうせい}: originality (creating something new)
- ⟦{創造性|そうぞうせい}→創造性：05214_souzousei⟧: creativity (broader, the ability to create)
- ⟦{独自性|どくじせい}→独自性：21975_dokujisei⟧: uniqueness, distinctiveness
- ⟦オリジナリティ→オリジナリティ：noentry⟧: originality (loanword, used casually)

WORD FORMATION:
{独|どく} (alone, original) + {創|そう} (create) + {性|せい} (quality/nature). The related adjective is ⟦{独創的|どくそうてき}→独創的：06242_dokusouteki⟧ (original, creative).
